title: Vectors: signature generation
description: Test vectors for signature generation. DONE - 5 valid vectors
close_reason: Satisfied by test/vectors/schnorr48.json: 5 valid signing vectors (empty message/zero seed, 'test', pangram, binary with nulls, LICHEN frame-like structure) plus a determinism vector requiring repeated sign() to reproduce the exact signature. Machine-consumed by python/tests/test_vectors.py::test_schnorr_vector, which for every valid vector rebuilds Identity.from_seed(seed) and asserts schnorr_sign(privkey,pubkey,msg) == expected 48-byte signature. Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k schnorr -q => 16 passed; uv run --extra dev pytest tests/crypto/test_schnorr48.py -q => 10 passed.
